name: Linear
description: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects, cycles, documents and comments through Linear's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Linear account.
examples: List my open Linear issues in the current cycle, grouped by status.
Create a Linear issue in the Web team for the broken password reset link, priority high, and assign it to me.
Summarize the comments on the most recently updated issue in our Mobile project.

zh-CN.name: Linear
zh-CN.description: 通过 Linear 官方托管的 MCP 服务查找、创建和更新 Linear 的 Issue、项目、迭代、文档与评论。用 Linear 账号登录。
examples: 列出我在当前迭代里还没完成的 Linear Issue，按状态分组。
在 Web 团队里为“重置密码链接失效”建一个 Linear Issue，优先级设为高，分配给我。
概括 Mobile 项目里最近更新的那个 Issue 下面的评论。
